target_claim: In the split local case, the reductions modulo the maximal ideal of all regular-representation matrices associated with the order basis can be simultaneously diagonalized.
source_quote: If $K_\mathfrak{p}\cong F_\mathfrak{p}^p$, then the minimal polynomial of each $e_i$ is a product of distinct linear factors, which means that all $\widetilde{A_i}$ can be simultaneously diagonalized.
